evidence_quotes: heeft de minister op grond van artikel 5.4 van de Waterwet het projectplan "Zandsuppletie Roggenplaat" (hierna: het projectplan) vastgesteld.
rationale: The Dutch Council of State (RvS) decision directly adjudicates a Ministerial project plan ("Zandsuppletie Roggenplaat" / sand nourishment on the Roggenplaat shoal) adopted pursuant to Article 5.4 of the Waterwet (Dutch Water Act), which governs the construction and modification of water management works (waterstaatswerken) in waterways/coastal waters. It is substantively about systemic water governance under both primary labels and does not involve household service connections or informal settlements.
